title: Aqua Paradise | Rosemary Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: Aqua Paradise — Stunning Home Near the Beach on 30A, Just Steps from the Community PoolFavorite Features:- 5 Minute Walk...
description_expanded: Aqua Paradise — Stunning Home Near the Beach on 30A, Just Steps from the Community Pool Favorite Features: - 5 Minute Walk to Beach - Multiple Balconies - Only a 5-minute walk to 30 Avenue’s Shops and Eateries More About Aqua Paradise: Located in the beautiful 30A beach town of Inlet Beach, Aqua Paradise is a stunning vacation rental that truly lives up to its name. This gorgeous property is located next to Shades restaurant, a local favorite, and is about a five-minute walk from the beach and just steps away from the community pool (heated during the colder months). Additionally, with four bedrooms, this lovely three-story home easily sleeps up to ten guests and features incredible amenities sure to impress. Aqua Paradise features an open-concept floor plan, which is perfect for entertaining groups. The first floor hosts the main living area with two couches and a flatscreen TV, the dining area, and a gourmet kitchen. The kitchen features a sleek modern design complete with black granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, white cabinetry, and a breakfast bar seating three. The dining area features a farmhouse dining table that seats at least eight people, which makes Aqua Paradise the perfect home to book for family gatherings. Additionally, you'll find beautiful travertine floors throughout the first level of the home and hardwood floors throughout the bedrooms. The third floor features another living space and access to the third-floor balcony. The media den on the third floor includes two couches, an armchair, vaulted ceilings, hardwood floors, and a flatscreen TV. With four bedrooms and four bathrooms, there's plenty of space for up to ten guests. The first two bedrooms both feature a queen bed and a twin bed in addition to flatscreen TVs, hardwood floors, and crown molding. The first bedroom is on the first floor and features an ensuite bathroom with a luxurious walk-in shower complete with subway tile and two shower-heads. The second bedroom is on the third floor and features an ensuite with a combination shower/bathtub. The third bedroom has a queen bed, hardwood floors, crown molding, a flatscreen TV, a balcony overlooking the community pool, and an ensuite bathroom fit for royalty. The ensuite bathroom includes a dual sink vanity, private water closet, roman bathtub, and a walk-in shower with two shower-heads. Finally, the fourth bedroom includes a queen bed, hardwood floors, a vaulted ceiling, a flatscreen TV, and an ensuite bathroom featuring a walk-in shower, dual sink vanity, and a private water closet. Outside, Aqua Paradise has the perfect entertainment area. Guests have access to a grill area and al fresco dining area on the third floor balcony. Additionally, the home is steps away from the community pool, the beach, and all the attractions in Inlet Beach.
